people.imagined: The spring auction at Vật Hoa Thị, evening, lanterns going up. A merchant has just made a bid she finds funny and she laughs out loud, fan up, while she is already working out what his laugh back will cost him. She has one child's name more to leave off her list tonight.
people.subject: The moment: at an evening market auction she laughs out loud at someone's bid, head tipped a little back, while her eyes stay fixed and calculating on the viewer. Face: broad and round with wide cheekbones, about thirty-five; sun-browned skin with freckles across the nose; full lips with a little red on them; strong straight dark brows; dark brown eyes; a small mole beside the left corner of her mouth; laugh lines. Hair: thick and black, coiled into a high double loop at the crown, held by a carved maple-wood comb with a pressed red maple leaf tucked behind it, and a pair of gold hair pins; two loose strands at the ears. Clothing: the sunset robes of a true disciple of the house: an outer robe of fine dusk-violet silk with a wide crossed collar and a sunset-gold gauze over-robe drifting from her shoulders, under it a deep maple-red robe showing at collar and cuffs, wide sleeves pushed back over strong brown forearms, collars embroidered with flying geese and sunset clouds in gold thread, a broad sash of dull gold brocade with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: her right hand holds an open folding fan of eight polished red-brown maple ribs with thin cream paper between them, lifted just below her chin; on each rib a small painted picture in gold: a fish, a horse, a boat, a bell, a pine, a goose, a lamp, a wave. Thin gold rings on her middle and ring fingers. Power: a faint amber glow of earth qi, like late sun on clay, gathers around her fingers and the fan, with a few golden motes rising and one green leaf-shaped glimmer of wood. Background: blurred warm lanterns and awnings of an evening market, soft with mist. Light: warm golden sunset spirit-light from the upper left, a luminous rim along her hair and sleeve. Expression: laughing, charming, cold underneath.

people.imagined: Dusk on a poor road outside a starving town. He has stopped at a doorway where an old woman is dying and is waiting, politely, to be asked in. The lamp is lit because he is working. He would never ring the bell; he holds it like a relic.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a poor road he waits politely at a dark doorway, the lamp lit because he is working. Face: long and thin with hollow cheeks, about seventy; papery pale skin with faint age spots; heavy-lidded eyes with pale brown irises; a small polite closed-mouth smile; thin grey brows; a sparse grey beard combed into a neat point. Hair: grey and thinning, combed back immaculately into a small topknot held by a plain dark-jade pin. Body: stooped, narrow shoulders, head carried a little forward. Clothing: the immaculate robes of an eerie wandering master, scrupulously clean: a long robe of fine ash-grey silk with a stand-up collar fastened at the throat by five knotted cloth buttons, a black inner collar, a sheer smoke-grey gauze over-robe with wide sleeves and faint silver cloud embroidery at the hem, clean cuffs. Lamp: a pole across his left shoulder; from its end hangs a squat black bronze lantern pierced with nine small round openings in three rows of three, and in each opening a tiny pale white flame leans toward the viewer as if breathing. Bell: in his right hand, held against his chest like a relic, a small bronze hand bell with a visible dark crack down one side, its clapper wound tight with red thread. Power: cold grey-green wisps of spirit-breath drift from the nine flames and curl around his shoulders like pale threads, a faint grey metal and water glimmer in the air; a strong, quiet aura of a Kết Đan master. Background: a blurred dusk road in thin mist and a dark doorway. Light: dim grey-violet dusk; the nine little flames throw a cold grey-green light up onto his face. Expression: courteous, patient, deeply unsettling.

people.imagined: First light in the high loft of the pavilion. The birds are waking on her; the drongo, always the first awake, has stepped onto her gauntlet. She is pleased with herself this morning: nine red-crested chicks hatched in the hidden loft, and nobody knows yet.
people.subject: The moment: first light in a high bird loft; she holds up her left forearm, where a black bird has just stepped onto her gauntlet, and smiles at the viewer. Face: narrow and angular, about forty-two, tanned; sharp cheekbones; a pointed chin with a small white crescent scar from a beak; quick dark eyes; a smile that lifts the corners of her mouth but leaves her eyes cold. Hair: thick dark brown-black, pinned up at the back in a loose untidy knot with two long blue tail feathers pushed through it, wisps escaping. Birds: on her right shoulder a small, slender sky-blue bird the size of a thrush, with a short pointed crest, a black eye-stripe, and one long thin ribbon tail hanging down over her arm to the elbow. On her raised left forearm a glossy black fork-tailed drongo with a single red eye, looking at the viewer. Clothing: the robes of the head of the house: flowing layers of leaf-green and russet silk with crossed collars embroidered with tiny birds in gold thread, over them a trailing mantle sewn from hundreds of shimmering moulted feathers, russet, brown and blue, overlapping like scales, crowned at the hair by the feathers; a fine leather-and-silk gauntlet on the left forearm; a carved bone whistle on a cord at her throat. Power: a soft green and ember-red aura of wood and fire qi surrounds her, tiny motes drifting up like down feathers, ember-red glints at the feather tips. Background: blurred jungle leaves and wooden perches in morning mist. Light: warm green-gold dappled spirit-light from the upper left, a luminous rim on the feathers. Expression: friendly, pleased with herself, calculating.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market's door at Thu Trì, in rain. He has been counting the people going in all night and someone has just looked at him a moment too long, the viewer. He is not sure if he has been noticed counting. The lip makes him look as if he is smirking, which makes it worse.
people.subject: The moment: at a market door at night in the rain, he has just been looked at and stares back, unsure whether he has been caught counting. Face, most important: a cleft-lip scar, clearly visible: a pale raised scar runs straight up from the middle of his upper lip to his left nostril, and that side of the lip is notched and lifted, so his mouth looks like a permanent crooked smirk. A lanky, plain, homely seventeen-year-old: a long face, a slightly flattened nose, ears that stick out, uneven dark eyebrows, small quick suspicious eyes. Hair: black, hacked short and sticking up, wet with rain. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of a low-realm cultivator, new and a little stiff on his thin frame: a blue-grey silk robe with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, a black silk cord belt, an oiled dark rain cape over his shoulders beaded with raindrops; no ornament. Hands: one hand at his chest, a tally cord of knotted string looped around the fingers. Power: only a faint thread of blue-grey water qi curling off his wet sleeve. Background: a blurred carved wooden doorway and a red paper lantern glowing in the rain, mist at the eaves. Light: damp amber lantern glow from one side, cool blue moonlit night on the other, silver rain catching the light. Expression: wary, paranoid, ready to bolt.
